name: codex-orchestration
description: Six-class taxonomy with artifact-aware and code-aware orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.10.5 uses six outcome-based classes: READ_ONLY, STANDARD_ARTIFACT, DESIGN_ARTIFACT, SMALL_TWEAK, BIG_TWEAK, and BUILD. Non-code deliverables are separated from code changes: standard artifacts use GPT-5.6 Luna / Max with a Terra / Max supervisor, design-critical artifacts use Terra / Max for implementation and supervision, small tweaks use Luna / Max with Terra / Max supervision, big tweaks use Terra / Max with a Sol / High supervisor, and every net-new code capability uses Sol / High with a Sol / Extra High supervisor. The Terra / Extra High orchestrator inherits only the current query plus compact routing continuity, returns the taxonomy route and a concrete reason to root, and stops. Root names every child from its actual model and emits the implementer-first and supervisor-second launches together. Both task roles start from small packets and independently load one private, versioned, exact context bundle; amendments update that bundle and the same running roles instead of spawning replacements. The gray desktop activity label follows the latest safe milestone with Thinking as its fallback. Later checkpoint relays contain only the new result and acceptance. Every release candidate contains an executable repository, deployment, probe, and tunnel plan; the supervisor rejects deferred deployment discovery, and the release turn executes the approved narrow plan without unrelated rebuilds or repeated passing checks. Implementer checkpoints, release results, supervisor decisions, and final reports use readable Markdown. Seven conflict-safe companion profiles preserve the taxonomy-only orchestrator, three implementation lanes, three supervisor lanes, continuity, and fixed routing.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
